entities.summary: Tobago, officially the Ward of Tobago, is an island and ward in Trinidad and Tobago. It is 35 kilometres northeast of the larger island of Trinidad and about 160 kilometres off Venezuela's northeastern coast. It is southeast of Grenada and southwest of Barbados.
